critical_limits: XCHG stores new null and returns old pointer or distinct zero fallback. Instruction atomicity does not establish object lifetime or higher-level threading.
RAX successful allocation return is machine behavior despite void pseudocode. It is not a recovered complete C++ prototype.
Comparison assigns AL only. Upper RAX remains unspecified. RET0 encodedc20000 is zero stack adjustment, not a zero RAX promise.
Unsigned alignment<=16 includes0 in the static branch. Alignment validity and external allocator signatures remain unresolved.

After zero handler result, UINT64_MAX first selects bad_array_new_length construction. Other sizes first call bad_alloc construction. Exact stores, strings, RTTI and IAT routes support labels. External no-return, fallthrough after unexpected return, unwind and full exception ABI remain unproved.
Four initially zero data IDs do not establish consumer runtime invariants. No conversion algorithm is exported.
Provider body capture does not establish complete CRT or executable behavior coverage.

remaining_obligations.claim: External handler, allocator, exception and Windows target implementation behavior remains unobserved.
Full resource object types, field ownership, exception layout/ABI, consumer locale ID invariants and C++ threading/lifetime semantics remain unresolved.
Ghidra terminal-call observations and hasNoReturn metadata do not prove external calls cannot return or throw exactly as modeled. Void allocation pseudocode is not a return contract.
Full CRT/runtime semantic review remains incomplete despite complete provider-body capture.
Rust reconstruction, Windows behavior and whole-app/media/UI/project parity are outside this static review.
